<documents>
<document id="card-renewal">
CardˆexpiryˆandˆrenewalˆWeˆmailˆaˆnewˆcardˆautomaticallyˆaboutˆ30ˆdaysˆbeforeˆyourˆcurrentˆcardˆexpires.ˆYouˆdon'tˆneedˆtoˆaskˆforˆit.ˆ##ˆWhatˆchangesˆTheˆrenewedˆcardˆhasˆtheˆsameˆcardˆnumber,ˆaˆnewˆexpiryˆdateˆandˆaˆnewˆsecurityˆcode.ˆMostˆmerchantsˆthatˆstoreˆyourˆcardˆgetˆtheˆnewˆexpiryˆdateˆautomatically,ˆbutˆsomeˆdon't,ˆsoˆcheckˆyourˆsubscriptions.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆwhenˆitˆarrivesˆActivateˆtheˆnewˆcardˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆYourˆoldˆcardˆkeepsˆworkingˆuntilˆyouˆactivateˆtheˆnewˆoneˆorˆuntilˆitˆexpires,ˆwhicheverˆcomesˆfirst.ˆ##ˆIfˆitˆdoesn'tˆarriveˆCheckˆthatˆyourˆaddressˆinˆtheˆappˆisˆcurrent.ˆIfˆyourˆoldˆcardˆexpiresˆandˆtheˆnewˆoneˆstillˆhasn'tˆarrived,ˆmessageˆsupportˆandˆwe'llˆsendˆanotherˆoneˆatˆnoˆcost.ˆ##ˆNoˆrenewal?ˆIfˆyourˆaccountˆisˆrestrictedˆorˆunderˆreview,ˆweˆcan'tˆsendˆaˆrenewalˆcardˆuntilˆthat'sˆresolved.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="card-metal">
TheˆPremiumˆmetalˆcardˆPremiumˆmembersˆgetˆaˆmetalˆdebitˆcard.ˆItˆworksˆexactlyˆlikeˆtheˆplasticˆcard,ˆwithˆtheˆsameˆnumber,ˆlimitsˆandˆcontrols.ˆ##ˆGettingˆyourˆmetalˆcardˆWhenˆyouˆupgradeˆtoˆPremium,ˆtheˆappˆasksˆwhetherˆyouˆwantˆaˆmetalˆcardˆnowˆorˆatˆyourˆnextˆrenewal.ˆIfˆyouˆorderˆitˆnow,ˆyourˆcurrentˆcardˆkeepsˆworkingˆuntilˆyouˆactivateˆtheˆmetalˆone.ˆ##ˆReplacingˆitˆReplacementsˆforˆaˆlost,ˆstolenˆorˆdamagedˆmetalˆcardˆareˆmetalˆandˆfreeˆonˆPremium.ˆExpeditedˆshippingˆisˆfreeˆonˆPremiumˆtoo,ˆandˆtakesˆ2ˆtoˆ3ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆIfˆyouˆleaveˆPremiumˆYourˆmetalˆcardˆkeepsˆworkingˆuntilˆitˆexpires.ˆAfterˆthat,ˆorˆifˆyouˆneedˆaˆreplacement,ˆyou'llˆgetˆaˆplasticˆcard.ˆ##ˆDisposalˆMetalˆcardsˆcan'tˆbeˆcutˆwithˆscissors.ˆWhenˆyouˆreplaceˆone,ˆyouˆcanˆmailˆitˆbackˆtoˆusˆinˆtheˆprepaidˆenvelopeˆthatˆcomesˆwithˆtheˆnewˆcard,ˆandˆwe'llˆrecycleˆit.ˆContactlessˆworksˆonˆmetalˆcardsˆtheˆsameˆwayˆitˆdoesˆonˆplastic.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="account-contact-change">
ChangingˆyourˆemailˆorˆphoneˆnumberˆYouˆcanˆchangeˆyourˆemailˆaddressˆandˆphoneˆnumberˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆProfile,ˆthenˆPersonalˆdetails.ˆ##ˆEmailˆEnterˆtheˆnewˆemail.ˆWeˆsendˆaˆconfirmationˆlinkˆtoˆtheˆnewˆaddressˆandˆaˆnoticeˆtoˆtheˆoldˆone.ˆTheˆchangeˆhappensˆwhenˆyouˆtapˆtheˆlink.ˆ##ˆPhoneˆnumberˆEnterˆtheˆnewˆnumberˆandˆconfirmˆtheˆcodeˆweˆtextˆtoˆit.ˆYou'llˆalsoˆbeˆaskedˆtoˆapproveˆtheˆchangeˆfromˆyourˆcurrentˆdevice.ˆ##ˆLostˆaccessˆtoˆyourˆoldˆphoneˆorˆemailˆMessageˆsupport.ˆBecauseˆthisˆisˆaˆcommonˆwayˆforˆfraudstersˆtoˆtakeˆoverˆaccounts,ˆweˆpassˆtheseˆrequestsˆtoˆourˆVerificationˆteam,ˆwhoˆmayˆaskˆforˆaˆnewˆselfie.ˆ##ˆAfterˆaˆchangeˆForˆ24ˆhoursˆafterˆaˆchange,ˆifˆyou'reˆalsoˆonˆaˆnewˆdevice,ˆBrookPayˆandˆexternalˆtransfersˆareˆlimitedˆtoˆ$500.ˆIfˆyouˆgetˆaˆnoticeˆaboutˆaˆchangeˆyouˆdidn'tˆmake,ˆmessageˆusˆrightˆaway.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
